title: Ryde Multi-Agent Autonomous Dispute Resolution System — Master Schema
description: Complete data contracts, state context objects, and structured outputs for the Ryde dispute resolution pipeline, including the PolicyAgent consultation invoked by JudgeAgent during deliberation and its knowledge-base feedback loop on human overrides. Fully compatible with official Ryde dispute datasets.

round_1_statements.title: Round1Statements
round_1_statements.description: Initial pleading objects submitted by Rider Advocate and Driver Advocate agents during ROUND_1_PLEADINGS.

policy_kb_update.description: Populated only when a human reviewer's decision during ESCALATED_HUMAN_REVIEW overrides JudgeVerdict (approval_decision is MODIFIED, OVERRIDDEN, or REJECTED_AUTO), triggering a PolicyAgent knowledge-base update. Null for FULLY_AUTOMATED cases and for human reviews that confirm the Judge's ruling as-is (CONFIRMED_AUTO).

CaseMetadata.title: CaseMetadata
CaseMetadata.description: Top-level case identification and workflow state-control object. The protocol is fixed at 2 advocate rounds (ROUND_1_PLEADINGS, ROUND_2_PROSECUTOR_AUDIT), followed by POLICY_CONSULTATION, JUDGE_DELIBERATION, and EXECUTION_ROUTER.

case_id.description: Unique identifier for the dispute case (e.g., DISP-001 or RYDE-DSP-20260322001).

dispute_type.description: Category of the dispute, determining the evidence-collection and policy-evaluation path.

current_state.description: Current state in the dispute resolution state machine.

current_round.description: The active advocate round number. 1 = ROUND_1_PLEADINGS, 2 = ROUND_2_PROSECUTOR_AUDIT. Remains 2 during POLICY_CONSULTATION, JUDGE_DELIBERATION, and EXECUTION_ROUTER, since the protocol has a hard limit of 2 rounds.

resolution_channel.description: The execution path determined by the EXECUTION_ROUTER gate. FULLY_AUTOMATED for confidence >= 0.75 with no safety/fraud flags; ESCALATED_HUMAN_REVIEW otherwise.

trip_id.description: Reference to the original Ryde trip.

DisputeClaim.title: DisputeClaim
DisputeClaim.description: Contains details of the initial dispute claim submitted by a party, including any attached image or receipt evidence.

case_id.description: Unique identifier for the dispute case.

trip_id.description: Reference identifier for the trip associated with this dispute claim.

description.description: Description of the dispute claim submitted by the party.

filed_by.description: Party who filed the dispute claim.

filed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the dispute claim was filed.

image_evidence.description: Optional structured image evidence submitted for this case. Omitted or empty when no images are available.

receipt_evidence.description: Optional cleaning receipts submitted for this case. Omitted or empty when no receipt is available.

AgentStatement.title: AgentStatement
AgentStatement.description: Structured statement submitted by an Advocate Agent (Rider or Driver) during ROUND_1_PLEADINGS.

agent_role.description: The agent role that produced this statement.

argument_summary.description: Concise natural-language summary of the party's argument or claim.

detailed_argument.description: Extended argument text with full reasoning, citations, and narrative.

requested_outcome.description: The outcome the party is requesting (e.g., 'full_refund', 'cleaning_fee_charge', 'case_dismissed').

requested_amount.description: Monetary amount requested by this party, in the trip's currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the requested amount.

evidence_references.description: List of identifiers of evidence already present in the case record (data_sources) that are cited in support of the argument.

EvidenceReference.title: EvidenceReference
EvidenceReference.description: A reference to a specific piece of evidence within the collected data sources.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for the evidence item (e.g., 'GPS-001', 'CHAT-003', 'IMG-002').

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this evidence demonstrates.

TargetedQuestion.title: TargetedQuestion
TargetedQuestion.description: A question generated by the Prosecutor Agent and directed to a specific party during ROUND_2_PROSECUTOR_AUDIT cross-examination. Each question is asked once; there is no follow-up question round.

question_id.description: Unique identifier for the targeted question (e.g., 'Q-001').

directed_to.description: The party to whom the question is directed.

question_text.description: The full text of the targeted question (e.g., 'Driver, please explain the 4-minute stationary stop at GPS point X').

evidence_context.description: Reference to the evidence that prompted this question (e.g., 'GPS-001: unexpected stop at 14:32').

category.description: The evidentiary category the question probes.

TargetedResponse.title: TargetedResponse
TargetedResponse.description: An Advocate Agent's single response to a specific targeted question from the Prosecutor. Responses are grounded solely in evidence already in the case record; no new evidence is introduced.

question_id.description: The ID of the targeted question this response addresses.

response_text.description: The full text of the party's response to the targeted question.

Round2CrossExam.title: Round2CrossExam
Round2CrossExam.description: Container for the Prosecutor's targeted questions and the Advocates' responses during ROUND_2_PROSECUTOR_AUDIT. Cross-examination is a single question-and-answer pass; once completed, the Prosecutor locks the fact record and emits the ProsecutorReport directly to the Judge.

targeted_questions.description: Questions generated by the Prosecutor Agent, directed to specific parties.

targeted_responses.description: Advocate responses addressing each targeted question.

round2_completed.description: Whether Round 2 cross-examination has been completed (all targeted questions have been answered). Completion triggers ProsecutorReport emission and the transition to JUDGE_DELIBERATION.

GPSCoordinate.title: GPSCoordinate
GPSCoordinate.description: A single GPS coordinate point with timestamp.

speed_kmh.description: Vehicle speed at this point in km/h.

status.description: Vehicle telemetry state during the trip.

UnexpectedStop.title: UnexpectedStop
UnexpectedStop.description: A detected unexpected stationary stop during the trip.

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the stationary stop in seconds.

deviation_flagged.description: Whether this stop is flagged as a route deviation or suspicious activity.

explanation_provided.description: Driver's or system's explanation for the stop, if available.

GPSAndTelemetry.title: GPSAndTelemetry
GPSAndTelemetry.description: GPS and telemetry data comparing actual vs. optimal route, deviations, and stops.

actual_route.description: Ordered GPS coordinates representing the actual driven route.

optimal_route.description: Ordered GPS coordinates representing the optimal/planned route.

deviation_distance_km.description: Total off-route deviation distance in kilometers.

unexpected_stops.description: Array of detected unexpected stationary stops.

trip_duration_seconds.description: Total actual trip duration in seconds.

optimal_duration_seconds.description: Estimated optimal trip duration in seconds for comparison.

max_speed_kmh.description: Maximum recorded speed during the trip.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single message in the in-app chat transcript between rider and driver.

message_id.description: Unique identifier for the chat message.

content.description: Full text content of the chat message.

safety_threat_keywords.description: Safety-threatening keywords detected in this message (e.g., 'weapon', 'assault', 'police').

ChatAndCommunication.title: ChatAndCommunication
ChatAndCommunication.description: In-app chat transcript, sentiment analysis, and safety threat detection.

overall_sentiment_score.description: Aggregate sentiment score for the entire conversation, -1.0 to 1.0.

safety_threat_keywords_detected.description: Whether any safety-threatening keywords were detected across the transcript.

flagged_messages.description: IDs of messages flagged for safety concerns.

FareBreakdown.title: FareBreakdown
FareBreakdown.description: Itemized fare breakdown for the trip.

promo_code.description: Promo or discount code applied, if any.

PaymentAndFareData.title: PaymentAndFareData
PaymentAndFareData.description: Payment and fare data including original breakdown, disputed amount, and promo details.

disputed_amount_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the disputed amount.

amount_already_refunded.description: Any amount already refunded to the rider before dispute resolution.

transaction_reference.description: Reference to the original payment transaction.

HistoricalProfile.title: HistoricalProfile
HistoricalProfile.description: Historical risk and behavioral profile for a single party (rider or driver).

party.description: The party this profile belongs to.

dispute_history_30d.description: Number of disputes filed by or against this party in the last 30 days.

dispute_history_90d.description: Number of disputes filed by or against this party in the last 90 days.

bad_faith_flag.description: Whether this party has been flagged for bad-faith behavior in prior cases.

trip_end_time.description: Time the trip was completed (drop-off). Used by POL-4 for the photo time window.

ImageExifGpsLocation.title: ImageExifGpsLocation
ImageExifGpsLocation.description: GPS coordinates extracted from image EXIF metadata. Unlike GPSCoordinate, this does not require a timestamp.

ProviderImageResult.title: ProviderImageResult
ProviderImageResult.description: Visual-analysis output from an actual model / vision provider. These fields are NEVER inferred from chat text or trip data.

is_ai_generated.description: Whether the image is detected as AI-generated (synthetic/fabricated).

ai_generated_confidence.description: Confidence score (0.0-1.0) for the AI-generated detection result.

stain_damage_classification.description: Classification of the stain or damage type detected in the image.

damage_severity.description: Estimated severity of the detected damage.

ImageEvidenceInput.title: ImageEvidenceInput
ImageEvidenceInput.description: A single image submitted as evidence. The presence of this object does not guarantee that an ExifAnalysis can be emitted; required EXIF or provider fields may still be missing.

image_id.description: Unique identifier for the submitted image (e.g., 'IMG-001').

image_url.description: URL or storage path to the image.

exif_timestamp.description: EXIF-embedded timestamp of when the photo was taken, normalized to ISO-8601 by the provider adapter.

image_hash.description: Perceptual or cryptographic hash of the image for recycled-image detection.

known_matches.description: Optional corpus mapping image_hash to a prior case_id for recycled-image comparison.

ReceiptOcrResult.title: ReceiptOcrResult
ReceiptOcrResult.description: Structured OCR output from reading a submitted receipt image. These fields are NEVER inferred from chat text or trip data.

amount.description: Monetary amount read from the receipt by OCR.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code read from the receipt.

merchant_name.description: Merchant or vendor name printed on the receipt, if legible.

receipt_date.description: Date printed on the receipt, normalized to ISO-8601 by the OCR adapter.

ocr_confidence.description: Confidence score (0.0-1.0) for the overall OCR read result.

ReceiptEvidenceInput.title: ReceiptEvidenceInput
ReceiptEvidenceInput.description: A single receipt submitted as evidence. The presence of this object does not guarantee that a ReceiptOcrResult can be emitted; the receipt image may be unreadable.

receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for the submitted receipt (e.g., 'RCP-001').

receipt_url.description: URL or storage path to the receipt image.

uploaded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the receipt was uploaded.

ocr_result.description: Structured OCR result. Omitted when the receipt could not be read.

DataSources.title: DataSources
DataSources.description: Container for all collected telemetry, communication, payment, and historical data sources. All data is collected and frozen at INIT_CLAIM; no new evidence is requested or introduced during the agent debate.

historical_profiles.description: Historical profiles for all parties involved.

ExifAnalysis.title: ExifAnalysis
ExifAnalysis.description: EXIF metadata and AI-generated image detection analysis for multimodal evidence (primarily Cleaning Fee disputes).

image_id.description: Unique identifier for the submitted image (e.g., 'IMG-001').

exif_timestamp.description: EXIF-embedded timestamp of when the photo was taken.

is_ai_generated.description: Whether the image is detected as AI-generated (synthetic/fabricated).

ai_generated_confidence.description: Confidence score (0.0-1.0) for the AI-generated detection result.

stain_damage_classification.description: Classification of the stain or damage type detected in the image.

damage_severity.description: Estimated severity of the detected damage.

exif_consistent_with_trip.description: Whether the EXIF timestamp and GPS location are consistent with the trip's time and route.

FraudAssessment.title: FraudAssessment
FraudAssessment.description: Fraud and bad-faith detection agent output, including risk score, risk factors, and collusion flags.

fraud_risk_score.description: Overall fraud risk score from 0.0 (no risk) to 1.0 (high risk).

risk_factors.description: List of identified fraud risk factors (e.g., 'Recycled photo detected', 'EXIF timestamp mismatch', 'Collusion pattern with driver').

collusion_warning_flag.description: Whether collusion between rider and driver is suspected.

collusion_evidence.description: Description of collusion evidence, if the flag is set.

abuse_pattern_detected.description: Whether an abuse pattern (e.g., repeated fake claims) is detected.

abuse_pattern_description.description: Description of the detected abuse pattern.

recommended_fraud_action.description: Recommended action based on fraud assessment.

EscalationProtocol.title: EscalationProtocol
EscalationProtocol.description: Escalation protocol and safety net configuration for routing cases to human review.

safety_threat_detected.description: Whether a safety threat was detected (violence keywords, physical dispute indicators).

escalation_reasons.description: Array of human-readable reasons for escalation (e.g., 'Low confidence 0.62', 'Possible physical dispute mentioned in chat', 'Recycled photo detected').

is_escalated.description: Whether this case is escalated to human review.

priority_level.description: Priority level assigned for human review queue routing.

escalation_threshold_confidence.description: The confidence score threshold below which escalation is triggered.

missing_crucial_evidence.description: Informational flag indicating that crucial evidence is missing (mirrors ProsecutorReport.missing_facts). Not an independent escalation trigger: missing crucial evidence lowers confidence_score, which escalates the case through the confidence threshold.

party_requested_human.description: Whether the party has requested human review after receiving the automated decision.

BonusModules.title: BonusModules
BonusModules.description: Container for bonus and verification modules: multimodal image/EXIF analysis, fraud assessment, and escalation protocol.

image_exif_analyses.description: Array of image and EXIF analysis results for submitted evidence images.

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description: A single fact item within the Prosecutor's audit report — verified, disputed, or missing.

supporting_evidence.description: Evidence references that support or relate to this fact.

party_relevance.description: Which party this fact is most relevant to.

policy_clause_reference.description: Reference to the relevant Ryde policy clause, if applicable (e.g., 'Ryde-Policy-4.2.1: Route Deviation').

confidence_level.description: Confidence level for this specific fact (0.0-1.0). Applicable to verified and disputed facts.

ProsecutorReport.title: ProsecutorReport
ProsecutorReport.description: Prosecutor Agent's final audit report, emitted at the end of ROUND_2_PROSECUTOR_AUDIT after tool-based verification and cross-examination. Submitted to the Judge Agent as the immutable fact record, containing verified facts, disputed facts, and missing facts.

verified_facts.description: Array of immutable, evidence-backed verified facts established during cross-examination.

disputed_facts.description: Array of unverified claims that remain contested between parties.

missing_facts.description: Array of critical evidence that is missing and could not be established during cross-examination.

prosecutor_summary.description: Prosecutor's overall summary of the audit findings and case posture.

RecommendedAction.title: RecommendedAction
RecommendedAction.description: Exact financial action recommended by the Judge Agent.

action_type.description: The type of financial action to execute.

refund_amount.description: Exact refund amount to be issued to the rider, if applicable. 0 if no refund.

cleaning_fee_amount.description: Cleaning fee to be charged to the rider, if applicable. 0 if not applicable.

JudgeVerdict.title: JudgeVerdict
JudgeVerdict.description: Judge Agent's final verdict including ruling, confidence, reasoning, recommended action, dual explanations, and execution payload.

ruling_type.description: The ruling outcome determined by the Judge Agent.

confidence_score.description: Confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) for the final ruling — the sole confidence score in the pipeline, produced by JudgeAgent after weighing ProsecutorReport's verified facts against PolicySuggestion. Scores >= 0.75 qualify for FULLY_AUTOMATED execution if no safety/fraud flags are raised.

reasoning_summary.description: Natural language explanation of the ruling, mapped to verified facts and policy clauses.

verified_fact_references.description: IDs of verified facts from the Prosecutor report that the ruling is based on.

policy_clauses_applied.description: Policy clause references applied in reaching the ruling.

precedent_references.description: References to prior similar cases used as precedent.

explanations.description: Dual natural language summaries tailored to each party.

explanation_for_rider.description: Plain-language explanation of the ruling addressed to the rider.

explanation_for_driver.description: Plain-language explanation of the ruling addressed to the driver.

deliberated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the Judge's deliberation.

ExecutionPayload.title: ExecutionPayload
ExecutionPayload.description: Execution output containing the autonomous or human-in-the-loop execution status and details.

execution_status.description: The execution outcome status. AUTO_EXECUTED for fully automated resolution; PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL for escalated cases.

case_final_status.description: Final archival status of the case.

HumanConfirmationDetails.title: HumanConfirmationDetails
HumanConfirmationDetails.description: Details of human operator review and confirmation. Populated ONLY when the case is escalated to human review.

reviewer_id.description: Unique identifier of the human operator who reviewed the case.

reviewer_name.description: Display name of the human reviewer.

override_reason.description: Reason provided by the human operator if they modified or overrode the auto-recommendation.

human_summary_card.description: Rich summary card content presented to the human operator for 1-click confirmation.

PolicyClauseReference.title: PolicyClauseReference
PolicyClauseReference.description: A specific clause from the Ryde policy library retrieved by PolicyAgent as relevant to the case.

clause_id.description: Unique identifier of the policy clause (e.g., 'Ryde-Policy-4.2.1').

clause_title.description: Short title of the clause (e.g., 'Route Deviation Refund Eligibility').

clause_text_summary.description: Paraphrased summary of the clause's operative text, not a verbatim reproduction.

relevance_summary.description: Why PolicyAgent judged this clause relevant to the case's verified facts.

PrecedentReference.title: PrecedentReference
PrecedentReference.description: A prior resolved case retrieved by PolicyAgent as a similar precedent.

precedent_id.description: Identifier of the prior case in the precedent store (may be a past case_id or a synthetic precedent_id assigned by a knowledge-base update).

similarity_summary.description: Why this prior case is similar to the current one.

prior_ruling_type.description: The ruling outcome of the precedent case.

PolicyConsultationRequest.title: PolicyConsultationRequest
PolicyConsultationRequest.description: Payload sent to PolicyAgent during POLICY_CONSULTATION, the state StateEngine transitions to immediately after ROUND_2_PROSECUTOR_AUDIT completes. Carries the Prosecutor's verified evidence and case summary so PolicyAgent can retrieve applicable clauses and precedents before JudgeAgent begins deliberation. JudgeAgent's own confidence_score is produced afterward, in JudgeVerdict, once the Policy suggestion has been weighed against the Prosecutor's findings.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this consultation request.

dispute_type.description: Category of the dispute, used to narrow policy clause retrieval.

verified_fact_ids.description: IDs of ProsecutorReport.verified_facts entries provided as grounding for the consultation.

prosecutor_summary.description: Copy of ProsecutorReport.prosecutor_summary passed along for context.

PolicySuggestion.title: PolicySuggestion
PolicySuggestion.description: PolicyAgent's response to a PolicyConsultationRequest, emitted during POLICY_CONSULTATION: the applicable clauses, matched precedents, and a suggested ruling for JudgeAgent to weigh against the Prosecutor's findings once StateEngine transitions to JUDGE_DELIBERATION. This is advisory only — JudgeAgent is not required to adopt suggested_ruling_type or suggested_recommended_action as-is.

request_id.description: ID of the PolicyConsultationRequest this suggestion answers.

applicable_clauses.description: Relevant policy clauses retrieved for this case.

matched_precedents.description: Similar past cases retrieved from the precedent store, if any.

suggested_ruling_type.description: PolicyAgent's suggested ruling outcome, for the Judge to weigh.

policy_confidence.description: PolicyAgent's confidence (0.0-1.0) in the clause match and suggested ruling, based on how directly the retrieved clauses and precedents apply.

rationale.description: Natural-language explanation of how the applicable_clauses and matched_precedents support the suggested ruling.

PolicyConsultation.title: PolicyConsultation
PolicyConsultation.description: Full record of the POLICY_CONSULTATION phase: PolicyAgent runs as its own state-machine step, immediately after ROUND_2_PROSECUTOR_AUDIT completes and before StateEngine transitions to JUDGE_DELIBERATION. JudgeAgent receives this record as input rather than invoking PolicyAgent itself.

PolicyKnowledgeBaseUpdate.title: PolicyKnowledgeBaseUpdate
PolicyKnowledgeBaseUpdate.description: Record of PolicyAgent updating its knowledge base (clause interpretation / precedent store) after a human reviewer's decision overrides JudgeVerdict during ESCALATED_HUMAN_REVIEW. Only created when the human's approval_decision differs from JudgeVerdict's own ruling_type/recommended_action (i.e. approval_decision is MODIFIED, OVERRIDDEN, or REJECTED_AUTO). Not created for FULLY_AUTOMATED cases or for CONFIRMED_AUTO human reviews.

update_id.description: Unique identifier for this knowledge-base update event.

trigger.description: The human approval_decision that triggered this update. Mirrors HumanConfirmationDetails.approval_decision.

clauses_flagged.description: clause_id values from the PolicySuggestion.applicable_clauses whose interpretation appears responsible for the mismatch, if identifiable.

mismatch_summary.description: Natural-language note on how and why the human decision differed from the Judge's ruling.

new_precedent_id.description: Identifier assigned to this case as it is indexed into PolicyAgent's precedent store, for retrieval by future PrecedentReference matches.
